_comment: Manual reviewer verdicts for the 076-f current-device assessment. Each entry is authored only after this reviewer opened the filed controller note AND the filed device frame and confirmed the row really shows that game. `identity` is the decisive field: a note describing a DIFFERENT game is never acceptance of the named game, no matter how good it looks. `status` uses only PASS / FIXED / NOT VALIDATED / N-A.

attention-odd-one-out.note: Controller note describes a 3x3 grid of triangles with one odd circle, Round 1/6, timer, Pause. Scored feedback quoted verbatim: "Time's up" with the odd one revealed. Pause overlay quotes "The challenge is hidden and the timers are frozen" with Resume/Quit; resume confirmed at Round 2/6. Result screen independently confirmed against the filed device frame item-for-item (Score 125, Accuracy 17%, First-try 17%, Rounds passed 1/6, Best streak 1, Timeouts 5, XP 12, Reward +12 XP +2 coins). Controls legible, Play again is the single red CTA, no clipping or overlap.

attention-sustained-vigilance.note: Controller note describes the sustained-vigilance mechanic specifically: central card showing a number with "Tap GO - hold on 4", Trial 1/30 chip, Score display, Pause control. Distinct sustained-timing mechanic retained. FRAME CAVEAT: the filed result.png was captured AFTER the journey's exit-and-reopen step and shows the Home screen, not a game state. It is therefore NOT independent corroboration of the reported states and is not cited as such. The PASS rests on the controller's state-by-state observation of the correct game mechanic, plus the source-equivalent historical A/F/P/R captures whose dependency closure is proven unchanged. A fresh terminal-state frame is owed on re-run.

attention-symbol-tracker.note: Controller note describes the tracking mechanic specifically: 3x3 grid of symbols with two highlighted symbol cards to memorize, "Track 2 symbols", "Memorize the highlighted symbols...", Round 1/5, Score 0, Pause. Scored feedback quoted: "Not quite", "You found 0 of 2 tracked symbols", "Time ran out - your picks were submitted as they stood."

flexibility-card-sort.note: Controller note describes the card-sort mechanic specifically: a target card (green square) with four choice cards (blue square, green circle, red square, blue circle) and the rule banner "Match by COLOR". Distinct sorting mechanic.

attention-visual-search.note: The filed note describes a DIFFERENT game: a "Demo" session for Flexibility with a "Match by SHAPE" button and four selectable shape cards. That is not attention-visual-search. The controller mis-navigated; this row does not evidence visual search at any state. Must be re-run.

flexibility-task-switch.note: Controller note is an unfilled skeleton: "(To be populated)" for scored feedback, pause and result. No state was evidenced. Must be re-run.

language-context-fit.note: Controller note is an unfilled skeleton: "(Pending observation)" for the active board. No state was evidenced. Must be re-run.

flexibility-color-stroop.note: The earlier run was killed before producing a review note. Must be re-run.
